evidence.quoted_text:
"manager_restarted": (
            (((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
             .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                 .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            and bool(((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and bool(((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")),
evidence.reason: The `manager_restarted` check only requires changed manager PIDs and invocation IDs. A guest reboot between the manager before/after snapshots changes both identifiers, so the check can credit a manager-only restart when the guest actually rebooted. The separate `boot_id_changed` check compares only the later reboot test's own before/after boot IDs and cannot detect that earlier reboot. Adding equality and nonempty checks for the manager before/after boot IDs is a routine verification correctness fix; the reboot check remains separate.
